annotations.title: Get a link to connect an account

description: Links to connect or reconnect social accounts per network, plus current status. For each ready network, hand over `directLink` first (single-use, 15 min, see `expiresAt`, skips Spica sign-in; for Bluesky it opens a handle + app-password form noted in `how`). Keep `link` (account page) as fallback. Ready: false means not connectable yet (say so). When `open` names a guide, read it with help_get for users without an account yet. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

network.description: One network by its key in capabilities, such as "instagram". Leave it out for every network that can be connected.
